stories.title: Vikings reunite with QB Cousins, trade 3rd-round pick to Raiders
stories.summary: Vikings are trading for quarterback Kirk Cousins, sending a 2027 third-round pick to the Raiders.

stories.title: Mendoza officially named Raiders' QB1: Top pick 'passed every test,' says GM
stories.summary: No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza was officially named the Raiders' starting quarterback Tuesday after the team traded Kirk Cousins to the Vikings.

stories.title: Brewers' Murphy 3-peats as top NL manager; White Sox's Venable wins AL honors
stories.summary: The Brewers' Pat Murphy became the first to win NL Manager of the Year in three straight seasons Tuesday, while Will Venable of the White Sox won AL honors.

stories.title: Source: Mets to meet with prized ace Skubal next week
stories.summary: The Mets are scheduled to meet with left-handed ace Tarik Skubal, the prize of this offseason's free agent class, next week in California, a source told ESPN.

stories.title: Chiefs snag needed help at WR, trade for Colts' Downs
stories.summary: The Chiefs have obtained needed help at wide receiver, acquiring Josh Downs in a trade with the Colts.
